title: ARE Method: Orbital Decompositions and Dihedral Cancellations for Determinants
summary: We develop the ARE method (Action-Rectification-Expansion), a structural framework for the organization of Leibniz terms in determinants through cyclic group actions and orbital decompositions. The symmetric group S_n is partitioned into (n-1)! disjoint orbits of size n under right composition by the cyclic group C_n. Each orbit admits a canonical representative and generates a family of determinant terms related by cyclic rotation.
